import BanditRLProof.OnlinePrescientBregmanSource
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Strong
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic

noncomputable section
open Set Finset
namespace BanditRL.OnlineConvex

theorem cumulative_regularizer_source_strongConvex {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (V : Set E) (hV : V.Nonempty)
    (psi : E → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (n : ℕ) (lam : ℝ)
    (hlam : 0 ≤ lam) (hpsi : StrongConvexOn V lam psi)
    (hbot : ∀ i < n, ∀ x, loss i x ≠ ⊥)
    (hdom : ∀ i < n, V ⊆ effectiveDomain (loss i))
    (hloss : ∀ i < n, ConvexOn ℝ V (fun x => (loss i x).toReal)) :
    let F : E → EReal := fun x =>
      (psi x : EReal) + ∑ i ∈ range n, loss i x + extendedIndicator V x
    SourceProper F ∧ effectiveDomain F = V ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V, F x = ((psi x + ∑ i ∈ range n, (loss i x).toReal : ℝ) : EReal)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ V, ∀ y ∈ V, ∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → a < 1 →
        F (a • x + (1 - a) • y) ≤
          (a : EReal) * F x + ((1 - a : ℝ) : EReal) * F y -
            (((lam / 2) * a * (1 - a) * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : EReal))

end BanditRL.OnlineConvex

shared_provider.definition:
theorem sourceProper_of_domain (f : E → EReal) (V : Set E)
    (hV : V.Nonempty) (hbot : ∀ z, f z ≠ ⊥)
    (hdom : V ⊆ effectiveDomain f) :
    SourceProper f := by
  refine ⟨hbot, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hV
  exact ⟨z, (f z).toReal, (EReal.coe_toReal (ne_of_lt (hdom hz)) (hbot z)).symm⟩

scope.classification: This is a derived sufficient-condition producer, not the full numbered source theorem. Regularizer-supplied curvature and convex component losses are stronger than assuming curvature of the total objective in Lemma7.5/7.47/15.31. Algorithm15.9 already prints a common-domain condition; common finiteness is a restriction relative to broader extended-real Algorithm7.1 branches, not a newly discovered omission there. Algorithm7.1 has psi:X to R with V subset X, while Corollary7.6 uses psi:V to R; arbitrary real extension outside V has no effect after the indicator. The below-top domain condition alone admits bottom; separate global no-bottom makes the included losses finite on V and prevents mixed-infinity addition. Zero n and zero lambda are allowed. No minimizer, support, finite-dimensionality, strict curvature, closedness or attainment is assumed or produced.
scope.modulus_boundary: The λ ≥ 0 binder is retained as a source condition. Mathlib StrongConvexOn itself permits an arbitrary real modulus; this does not authorize removing the binder.
scope.proof_topology: For each included loss, combine below-top on V with no-bottom to identify its value with the coercion of its real part. Induct over the finite sum to exclude bottom globally and compute the sum on V. The indicator then gives the real finite identity on V and top outside, hence dom(F)=V. Apply the existing sourceProper_of_domain to this actual F, its derived no-bottom property and nonempty V. Finally sum each loss-convexity inequality and add the strongly convex regularizer inequality; rewrite the finite identities and retain precisely (lambda/2)a(1-a)||x-y||^2 in the original E norm. The source proof graph is the sufficient regularizer-curvature branch feeding cumulative parents; attainment and stability nodes are excluded as still open. The implementation uses componentwise finite sums and the shared properness parent, not a supplied-support wrapper.
